info.name: Hostel Mess API
info.description: Run the folders in order with the Collection Runner. Pick the Hostel Mess - Local environment first. Folder 0 logs in and saves the tokens.

request.description: Generates fresh test dates for this run, then registers the test student. 409 means the student already exists, which is fine.

exec: pm.test("Dinner is now true", function () { pm.expect(j.dinner).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("Exactly one record for the test date", function () { pm.expect(j.filter(function (x) { return x.mealDate === pm.environment.get("mealDate"); }).length).to.eql(1); });

request.description: If this returns 409, a leave from an earlier run overlaps these random dates. Run folder 0 again to get new dates.

exec: pm.test("Has at least one record", function () { pm.expect(j.length).to.be.at.least(1); });
pm.test("Seeded medicines with status", function () { pm.expect(j.length).to.be.at.least(10); pm.expect(j[0].status).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("No out of stock or expired items", function () { j.forEach(function (m) { pm.expect(["OUT_OF_STOCK","EXPIRED"]).to.not.include(m.status); }); });
pm.test("At least one match", function () { pm.expect(j.length).to.be.at.least(1); });
pm.test("Is a non-empty list", function () { pm.expect(j.length).to.be.at.least(1); });

request.description: Sets known rates so the bill amounts in the next tests can be checked exactly.

exec: pm.test("Rates saved", function () { pm.expect(j.breakfastRate).to.eql(80); pm.expect(j.lunchRate).to.eql(150); pm.expect(j.dinnerRate).to.eql(150); pm.expect(j.lowStockThreshold).to.eql(10); });

request.description: Generates three demo dates in one future month, then adds all meals for day 1.

exec: const mine = j.find(function (b) { return b.userId === parseInt(pm.environment.get("studentId"), 10); });
pm.test("Amount is 1140 (3 days x 380)", function () { pm.expect(mine.totalAmount).to.eql(1140); });
const mine = j.find(function (b) { return b.billMonth === parseInt(pm.environment.get("billMonth"), 10) && b.billYear === parseInt(pm.environment.get("billYear"), 10); });

item.name: 59 Student submits leave for day 2 and 3

request.description: If this returns 409, a leave from an earlier run overlaps. Run this folder again.

item.name: 61 Student sees own bill (AFTER leave, must drop)

exec: const mine = j.find(function (b) { return b.billMonth === parseInt(pm.environment.get("billMonth"), 10) && b.billYear === parseInt(pm.environment.get("billYear"), 10); });
pm.test("Bill is lower than before", function () { pm.expect(mine.totalAmount).to.be.below(parseFloat(pm.environment.get("billBefore"))); });
pm.test("1 breakfast, 1 lunch, 1 dinner", function () { pm.expect(j.breakfastCount).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.lunchCount).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.dinnerCount).to.eql(1); });
pm.test("All counts are 0", function () { pm.expect(j.breakfastCount).to.eql(0); pm.expect(j.lunchCount).to.eql(0); pm.expect(j.dinnerCount).to.eql(0); });

item.name: 64 Student edits a meal on leave day (400)
65 Admin lists bills for the month

exec: const mine = j.find(function (b) { return b.userId === parseInt(pm.environment.get("studentId"), 10); });

item.name: 67 Generate again, still one bill per student

exec: pm.test("Student appears once", function () { var id = parseInt(pm.environment.get("studentId"), 10); pm.expect(j.filter(function (b) { return b.userId === id; }).length).to.eql(1); });
